items.title: Uber’s Legal AI Agent Cuts Contract Review Time by 20% with Rules and RAG
items.summaryShort: Uber’s Legal AI Agent Cuts Contract Review Time by 20% with Rules and RAG. Uber’s Legal Redlining Agent reviews contract changes in Microsoft Word using RAG, historical lawyer feedback, and deterministic policy rules.

items.title: Airbnb Introduces CASTLE for Training Natural Language Search Models with Synthetic Data
items.summaryShort: Airbnb Introduces CASTLE for Training Natural Language Search Models with Synthetic Data. Airbnb researchers have introduced CASTLE, a framework designed to address the cold-start problem in natural language search.

items.title: Cybersecurity AI startup Corma reaches $1B valuation in about 3 months
items.summaryShort: Cybersecurity AI startup Corma reaches $1B valuation in about 3 months. Three months since introducing its product, AI cybersecurity startup Corba has raised a $125 million Series A at a $1 billion valuation led by NEA.

items.title: Cyber giant Infoblox confirms security incident after hackers access ‘company information'
items.summaryShort: Cyber giant Infoblox confirms security incident after hackers access ‘company information'. The cybersecurity and automation giant said it's working with outside investigators to understand the scale of the breach.
